title: Tulle Sleeveless A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at every wedding in this dreamy tulle A-line dress! Featuring a sleeveless design and a flowy silhouette, this elegant piece is perfect for dancing the night away while exuding timeless charm and effortless grace.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
